race.comment: NOTTOLOOK (3) comes back across the border having won well at Murray Bridge last time out as favourite over 2500m. He'd been thereabouts in this sort of level prior and is still an improving, lightly raced type. Hard to hold out. SHULTZY (1) is consistent around this level, coming through a stronger race at Caulfield last time out when fifth. That should stack up well. FIOROWNGOOD (4) has won three in a row and was dominant in easier at Mt Gambier. Up a level now but hard to knock. ROARING ENGINE (12) presents third up and ready to win as does MR O'REILLY (2) who chased the Coongy winner last time and sets up well on speed.
